profile.name: Jakub Zehner
profile.intro: I build web applications end to end — currently with .NET and React — working across practically every stage of development, from data models and backend services to polished, user-facing frontends. My background also spans Spring, C++ and Python, including machine learning research at the intersection of AI and software engineering. I care about clean architecture, strong typing, and the small details that make software feel solid.

experience.summary: Working on Appmedica — a platform that helps hospitals and clinics manage medical equipment and infrastructure. Involved end to end, across practically every stage of development: from the data model and .NET backend services to the React frontend.

Maintained and developed software managing Base Transceiver Stations (BTS) in global telecommunications networks, using C++, Protobuf and Boost. Implemented new features, investigated issues and fixed defects in a reliability-critical system, with unit and integration tests and established CI/CD pipelines.

Developed an internal web tool supporting the work of multiple teams across the organization, built with React, Meteor.js and MongoDB. Implemented new features, integrated APIs, refactored backend code and took part in code reviews — also as a reviewer.
